title: Class
description: REOSERV data/pub/classes/<id>.json — one EcfRecord per file. See src/utils/load_class_file.rs.

parent_type.description: Parent class id. 0 for base classes.

stat_group.description: Stat group bucket the class belongs to.

unarmed_attack_ms.description: Swing interval (ms) with no weapon, or with a weapon that doesn't author attack_rate_ms. Lower = faster.

move_rate_ms.description: Base interval (ms) between steps for this class. Lower = faster.

playable.description: Whether players can pick this class at character creation. Default true; uncheck to hide an unfinished class. Enforced server-side and pushed live to the eoweb class picker (no deploy).
